children: SIR Corp. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $306.3M, up 5.8% from $289.4M, and adjusted net earnings of $9.9M versus $9.8M. The current year had 52 weeks versus 53 weeks in fiscal 2025.
Adjusted earnings were nearly flat year over year despite revenue growth; fiscal 2025 included an extra operating week.
Growth included new restaurant openings; comparable sales growth was 1.8% for the year.
The smaller loss was primarily driven by a lower non-cash amortized-cost expense, lower interest costs and higher restaurant earnings.
Quarterly consolidated same-store sales declined 1.6%, tempering reported growth from new locations.
Cash was down from $12.5M a year earlier; approximately $30.3M remained available under the stated maximum borrowing amount.

This is an annual operating update showing modest adjusted-earnings growth and revenue expansion, alongside a reported net loss affected by non-cash accounting changes. Further evidence of same-store sales improvement and the planned additions to the royalty pool would be needed to make this a larger catalyst.
Based on the original press release from SIR Royalty Income Fund distributed by PR Newswire.
